jobs.title: Automation and AI Engineer
jobs.snippet: Featured full-time, permanent Automation and AI Engineer role in NobleOak's IT department. Sydney CBD, broad exposure, impactful work across insurance operations.
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Computer Vision Engineer
jobs.snippet: Build high-performance CV systems from first principles for drone defence. Australian citizenship required. AIM Defence is a Melbourne deep-tech startup making laser-based counter-drone systems.
jobs.description:
## About AIM Defence

AIM is a deep-tech startup based in Melbourne, Australia, building advanced high-power laser systems to protect people and critical infrastructure from weaponised drones. AIM's technology is at the cutting edge of directed-energy defence.

## The Role

As a Computer Vision Engineer, you will develop high-performance computer vision and machine learning systems from first principles, contributing directly to Australia's sovereign defence capability.

## Responsibilities

- Design and implement computer vision algorithms for real-time drone detection, tracking, and classification
- Build and optimise high-performance CV/ML systems, including algorithms and CUDA kernels for GPU deployment
- Develop ML training pipelines and inference infrastructure for edge deployment in live systems
- Collaborate with a top-tier engineering team on hardware-software integration
- Maintain awareness of emerging CV/ML developments relevant to defence applications

## Requirements

- Strong background in computer vision and deep learning (PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Experience with C++ and Python for high-performance systems
- Familiarity with GPU programming (CUDA) is highly desirable
- Australian citizenship with eligibility to obtain and maintain a Baseline security clearance
- Passion for applied ML in real-world, safety-critical systems

## Benefits

- Work on one of the most technically challenging and impactful defence problems in Australia
- Small, high-calibre team with a strong engineering culture
- Melbourne facility with a clear mission: protecting people from weaponised drones

jobs.title: 推荐算法实习生（2026届）
jobs.snippet: 参与小红书核心推荐场景算法研发，提升点击率、互动率等核心指标。薪资200-500元/天，北京办公。
jobs.description:
## 关于小红书

小红书是中国领先的生活方式内容社区和电商平台，月活用户超3亿，连接创作者与消费者。小红书的推荐系统是其核心竞争力之一。

## 岗位职责

- 参与小红书核心推荐场景（首页、搜索、发现页等）的算法研发，提升场景的点击率、互动率、停留时长等核心指标
- 参与面向海量创作者的成长机制和商业化机制设计，提升创作者留存和商业化规模等核心指标
- 设计面向消费者、创作者、平台的多方生态机制和流量机制算法建设
- 参与推荐算法的召回、排序模型及策略机制工作

## 岗位要求

- 计算机、统计、数学等相关专业在读，2026届毕业生
- 具备扎实的机器学习基础，熟悉推荐系统、深度学习等相关技术
- 有推荐算法或搜索算法实习经验者优先
- 熟练使用Python，有大规模数据处理经验优先

## 薪资与福利

- 实习日薪：200–500元/天
- 工作地点：北京
- 优秀实习生可获转正机会
